summary: DataMeds AI, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an updated record date of August 7, 2026 for the distribution of Dream Bowl 2026 Meme Coins to stockholders, initially one coin per share, now increased to fifty coins per share. The distribution date will be set later in coordination with DataVault AI, Inc. (NASDAQ:DVLT). Approximately 1,533,930 shares, a majority, are subject to lock-up agreements. This is a non-cash distribution to shareholders, classified as a capital return. Watch for final distribution date and potential market impact from the meme-coin issuance.
